_note: v2.4 plan 01 T1 red fixture (no backend). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-01-middle-delete.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. Three player lines, each consumed by its own boundary with one latching delta and one fact whose evidence quotes that line. record_state is taken at the boundary before the target line, then ST's real deleteMessage removes the MIDDLE line. MESSAGE_DELETED carries the post-delete chat.length (host-facts 01-H1), so before the T1 fix the rollback starts at 2 instead of 1: lit_lamp and the lamp fact, both derived from the removed line, survive and stateEquals FAILS (red). After the fix the decoder names message 1 and the state equals the recording.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, boundary: state.boundary };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const values = state.blackboard.values; if (lines.length !== 3 || !String(lines[1]).includes('oil lamp')) throw new Error(`the chat is not the three scripted lines, so host_delete 1 would not remove the lamp line: ${JSON.stringify(lines)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 2) throw new Error(`the engine consumed up to message ${state.lastMessageId}, expected 2`); for (const key of ['took_key', 'lit_lamp', 'found_map']) if (values[key] !== true) throw new Error(`${key} did not land before the delete: ${JSON.stringify(values)}`); const facts = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((e) => e.tier === 'facts').map((e) => ({ text: e.text, messageId: e.messageId })); return { values, facts, boundary: state.boundary };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const fallbacks = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((e) => /message delete/.test(e.summary)).map((e) => e.summary); if (fallbacks.length) throw new Error(`the delete was not decoded exactly: ${JSON.stringify(fallbacks)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 0) throw new Error(`the engine still claims message ${state.lastMessageId} as consumed; the map line now at index 1 would never be read again`); return { lines, lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId, values: state.blackboard.values };
